text:
sophie: quick heads-up — ran a shadow burn of quant4v3 on the long-doc slice (n=25k). Observed 95p latency +38ms and slight MRR drop on rerank for long-context prompts. Sharing quick diffs.

alex: can you paste the perf delta and the eval slice?

sophie: perf: p50 +2ms, p95 +38ms, p99 +72ms. quality: rerank_mrr -0.9%, longdoc_f1 -0.6%.

chen: yikes p99 +72ms is worrying. what batch/kv settings?

sophie: batch=8, kv_cache enabled, kernel=nvcc-optimized, quant profile: nf4-int4. shadow run id: sr-2026-03-18-77

deploy-bot: shadow run sr-2026-03-18-77 completed — requests: 25,432; errs: 12; avg_qps: 120

alex: any correlation with sequence length? distribution looks heavier tail?

sophie: yes — sequences >2k tokens had p95 +65ms vs <512 had +12ms. So longcontext sensitive.

maya: what's our current canary fallback rule? last I saw: auto-fallback if quality delta <= -1% OR latency p95 increase >= +50ms

david: that rule would trigger here (p95 +38ms <50ms) so it wouldn't auto-fallback. quality delta -0.9% < -1% so also no fallback. borderline.

chen: propose tightening for long-docs: add slice-aware gating. If longdoc_f1 or mrr delta <= -0.5% AND p95 delta >= +30ms then immediate fallback.

alex: agree. Also add a soft hold: if borderline for 24h, limit traffic to 5% and run targeted evals.

sophie: here's a suggested gating snippet:

```yaml
gates:
  - slice: long-doc
    metrics:
      - name: rerank_mrr
        fail_if_delta_pct: -0.5
      - name: latency_p95
        fail_if_delta_ms: 30
    action: immediate-fallback
  - global:
    metrics:
      - name: rerank_mrr
        fail_if_delta_pct: -1.0
    action: progressive-rollout(5%)
```

maya: nice. I'd also add a noise buffer to prevent flaps: require condition hold for 3 consecutive 15m windows.

david: logging note: add per-request seq_len bucket to telemetry so we can surface tail triggers faster.

sophie: I'll push a PR for gate config + telemetry. For now, I'll rollback the quant4v3 shadow and re-run with kv tuning.

sophie: @alex @chen assign to QA to run targeted rerank eval on longdocs tomorrow?

alex: on it. I'll create the eval harness and notify.

chen: thx. also let's run an A/B with nf4-int8 variant to compare quality/lats.

deploy-bot: canary-config updated by sophie — gate draft created: /configs/gates/longdoc-tighter.yaml

sophie: closing loop — rollback scheduled in 15m; will update results after targeted runs :thumbsup:
